title: GST registration limits for small shops
summary: When a small business needs to register for GST.

sections.heading: What is the registration limit?
paragraphs: You need GST registration when your yearly sales cross a limit. This limit is called the threshold.
The limit is different for goods and for services. It can be lower in some states.

sections.heading: What if you are below the limit?
paragraphs: You may not need to register. Some businesses choose to register anyway. Ask your CA if it suits you.
